creation: Original layout of this study's saved results; no external figure or empirical value reused.
data_rule: Macro-F1 recalculated from saved confusion matrices; original main table never replaced by new same-text values.

protocols.WM_v2: frozen deduplicated remigration; not an independent untouched test
protocols.mechanism_original: same semantics and visual cache; classwise versus global; original empirical enable rule
protocols.mechanism_uniform: same cached scores, both classwise/global disable fallback; post-hoc robustness analysis

uncertainty.top_panels: mean ± sample SD, ddof=1, ten support seeds; percent
uncertainty.lower_panels: mean of seed-paired differences ± unadjusted two-sided 95% Student t interval, df=9; pp
uncertainty.scope: Fixed query sets; support-sampling uncertainty only; no multiple-comparison adjustment

same_text_control: Not plotted. New same-text/re-encoded ProKeR belongs to a separate comparison in the manuscript.
one_shot: No residual estimation; classwise method exactly restores the same prescribed anchor, shown by hollow blue circle and orange center. WM 1-shot uses a visual prototype; FGVC 1-shot uses Tip-Adapter-F, which includes generic CLIP prompts.

geometry.shared_scales: Top panels share the Macro-F1 axis; bottom panels share the pp axis.
